svg.title: kbexplorer — a unifying overlay network
svg.desc: Many systems of record feed a continuously evolving knowledge-graph overlay, kbexplorer, which projects representations to many kinds of consumers.
svg.text: one continuously-evolving knowledge graph over many systems of record, projected to many consumers
one knowledge graph · kg:// identity · sources → providers → engine → representation
Each layer depends only on the contracts in @anokye-labs/kbexplorer-core — swap any layer without touching the others.
